materials.summary: Reference single-cup dine-in americano workflow (non-authoritative teaching evidence only)

steps.description: Read order and live EvidenceScene; verify control_ready and uniquely bind a single rigid cup.
Place selected cup under coffee machine spout and re-observe L2 pouring safety.
If l2_pouring_safety.safe_to_pour is False after placement, recenter cup under spout and re-observe.
Start coffee machine once; if receipt is unknown, query_command_status and never reissue brew.
Wait for coffee ready, retrieve and deliver cup to target_slot, and complete_order_delivery.
